sourceRefs.locator: Accession 38.40.243. Object description, dimensions, turquoise opaque glaze, date, the excavated site of Sabz Pushan, and the 1938 division of finds.
Map of Nishapur and Environs and the section on excavation of the Sabz Pushan residential quarter.
Unit 6, The City of Nishapur, introductory account and discussion of games and household objects recovered in excavations.

note.de: Im Wohnviertel Sabz Puschan gruben Archäologen eine türkis glasierte Schale aus. Die Datierung der Keramik umfasst das zehnte Jahrhundert. Der Kartenpunkt zeigt das Gebiet der mittelalterlichen Stadt.
note.en: A turquoise-glazed bowl came to light in the residential quarter of Sabz Pushan. The pottery is dated to the tenth century. The map locates the area of the medieval city.
